backup.production_rule: take a fresh encrypted set immediately before the window; the named set is 1,674,192 bytes with SHA256SUMS verified OK on 2026-09-08 and has no restore proof yet

forward_verification.name: wave_3_to_5_tables_exist
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.cleaning_verification_evidence') is not null and to_regclass('public.cleaning_verification_reviews') is not null and to_regclass('public.inventory_stock_movements') is not null and to_regclass('public.inventory_forecasts') is not null and to_regclass('public.inventory_purchase_reviews') is not null and to_regclass('public.finance_reconciliation_candidates') is not null and to_regclass('public.finance_reconciliation_reviews') is not null and to_regclass('public.finance_reconciled_facts') is not null and to_regclass('public.management_target_versions') is not null

forward_verification.name: operations_tables_are_not_anon_readable
forward_verification.query: select not has_table_privilege('anon','public.cleaning_verification_evidence','select') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.inventory_purchase_reviews','select') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.finance_reconciled_facts','select')

forward_verification.name: ops_roles_cannot_read_finance
forward_verification.query: select not public.staff_access_allowed('cleaner','read_finance',null,'aal2') and not public.staff_access_allowed('inspector','read_finance',null,'aal2') and not public.staff_access_allowed('maintenance','read_finance',null,'aal2') and public.staff_access_allowed('finance','read_finance',null,'aal2')

forward_verification.name: one_final_reconciliation_review_per_candidate
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'public' and indexname = 'finance_reconciliation_final_review_idx'

forward_verification.name: one_final_cleaning_review_per_session
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'public' and indexname = 'cleaning_verification_final_review_idx'

rollback.safe_until: before any verification evidence, purchase review or reconciliation review row is written; after writes, retain the rows and apply a forward fix or restore the named production set

steps.name: disable_wave_entry_points
steps.action: revoke EXECUTE on public.record_cleaning_verification_evidence and public.review_cleaning_verification; the inventory and finance tables have no RPC entry point of their own yet

steps.name: preserve_review_records
steps.action: retain evidence, forecast, purchase-review and reconciliation rows; they are the audit trail for every decision already taken

steps.name: leave_existing_operations_untouched
steps.action: do not revert record_inventory_usage or submit-cleaning behaviour; this release adds parallel tables and reads nothing the live path writes

feature_flags.name: purchase_review_ui
feature_flags.required_state: off until the owning product surfaces it; review must never be able to place an order

feature_flags.name: finance_reconciliation_reporting
feature_flags.required_state: off until reports disclose freshness and exclusions, which is a stated P7 acceptance criterion

compatibility.evidence: All three migrations create new tables, indexes and functions only. A static scan on 2026-09-08 found no rename, drop, truncate or delete in any of them, and none replaces public.staff_access_allowed, so no existing authority decision changes. Left unverified until the matching pgTAP files under supabase/tests/database are run, which needs a working local Postgres.

stop_conditions: the production restore point is older than the window
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
a real-role smoke test has not confirmed that purchase review cannot order and that an OPS role cannot read Finance - both are stated P7 acceptance criteria, not optional checks
